sloka: बाल एव हि मातुल्यं भरतो नायितस्त्वया ।सन्निकर्षाच्च सौहार्दं जायते स्थावरेष्वपि ॥२-८-२८॥
transliteration: bāla eva hi mātulyaṁ bharato nāyitastvayā ।sannikarṣācca sauhārdaṁ jāyate sthāvareṣvapi ॥2-8-28॥

translations.english: Bharata has been sent by you right from his childhood to his maternal uncle's house. Proximity creates friendship even amongst the inanimate objects.
